reading: Some people under 25 could get less money from the government under new plans.
Benefits are government payments to help people who need support.
Alan Milburn's report is expected to suggest changes to benefits for illness or disability.
Under the plans, young people would get a basic payment instead.
Some could get extra money for daily costs linked to their health problems.
People with more serious disabilities who cannot work would get a higher payment.
The report is also expected to suggest more help for young people looking for work.
This could include work experience and help from personal advisers.
Milburn said the changes would affect people already getting benefits and new people asking for them.

vocabulary.definition: Money the government gives people who need help.
Amounts of money given to someone.
At a simple level, without anything extra.
